AND artifact_id = 'evtx' AND CAST(json_extract_string(payload_json, '$.EventId') AS INTEGER) = 4688 AND ( ( json_extract_string(payload_json, '$.ExecutableInfo') ILIKE '%\\reg.exe%' AND json_extract_string(payload_json, '$.ExecutableInfo') ILIKE '%query%' AND ( json_extract_string(payload_json, '$.ExecutableInfo') ILIKE '%-v%' OR json_extract_string(payload_json, '$.ExecutableInfo') ILIKE '%/v%' ) ) OR ( ( json_extract_string(payload_json, '$.ExecutableInfo') ILIKE '%\\powershell.exe%' OR json_extract_string(payload_json, '$.ExecutableInfo') ILIKE '%\\pwsh.exe%' ) AND ( json_extract_string(payload_json, '$.ExecutableInfo') ILIKE '%Get-ItemPropertyValue%' OR json_extract_string(payload_json, '$.ExecutableInfo') ILIKE '%gpv%' ) ) ) AND ( json_extract_string(payload_json, '$.ExecutableInfo') ILIKE '%\\SOFTWARE\\Microsoft\\Windows Defender%' OR json_extract_string(payload_json, '$.ExecutableInfo') ILIKE '%\\SOFTWARE\\Microsoft\\Windows NT\\CurrentVersion%' OR json_extract_string(payload_json, '$.ExecutableInfo') ILIKE '%\\SOFTWARE\\Microsoft\\Windows\\CurrentVersion\\Uninstall%' OR json_extract_string(payload_json, '$.ExecutableInfo') ILIKE '%\\SYSTEM\\CurrentControlSet\\Control\\TimeZoneInformation%' OR json_extract_string(payload_json, '$.ExecutableInfo') ILIKE '%\\SYSTEM\\CurrentControlSet\\Services%' )

sql: SELECT audit_id, ts_utc, artifact_id, event_type, json_extract_string(payload_json, '$.Provider') AS provider, json_extract_string(payload_json, '$.PayloadData1') AS payload_data1, json_extract_string(payload_json, '$.PayloadData2') AS payload_data2, json_extract_string(payload_json, '$.Computer') AS computer_name FROM unified_events WHERE case_id = ? AND artifact_id = 'evtx' AND json_extract_string(payload_json, '$.Channel') = 'Application' AND CAST(json_extract_string(payload_json, '$.EventId') AS INTEGER) = 33205 AND json_extract_string(payload_json, '$.Provider') ILIKE '%MSSQLSERVER%AUDIT%' AND (payload_json ILIKE '%statement:TRUNCATE TABLE%' OR payload_json ILIKE '%statement:DROP TABLE%' OR payload_json ILIKE '%statement:DROP DATABASE%')

AND artifact_id = 'evtx' AND CAST(json_extract_string(payload_json, '$.EventId') AS INTEGER) = 4688 AND ( ( json_extract_string(payload_json, '$.ExecutableInfo') ILIKE '%Windows Media Player%osk.exe%' OR json_extract_string(payload_json, '$.raw.Payload') ILIKE '%Windows Media Player%osk.exe%' ) OR ( ( json_extract_string(payload_json, '$.ExecutableInfo') ILIKE '%\cmd.exe%' OR json_extract_string(payload_json, '$.raw.Payload') ILIKE '%\cmd.exe%' ) AND ( json_extract_string(payload_json, '$.PayloadData1') ILIKE '%mmc.exe%' OR json_extract_string(payload_json, '$.raw.Payload') ILIKE '%mmc.exe%eventvwr%' ) ) ) AND ( json_extract_string(payload_json, '$.raw.Payload') ILIKE '%S-1-16-12288%' OR json_extract_string(payload_json, '$.raw.Payload') ILIKE '%S-1-16-16384%' OR json_extract_string(payload_json, '$.raw.Payload') ILIKE '%High Mandatory Level%' OR json_extract_string(payload_json, '$.raw.Payload') ILIKE '%System Mandatory Level%' )

WITH filtered AS (
    SELECT
        audit_id, ts_utc, artifact_id, event_type, payload_json,
        COALESCE(json_extract_string(payload_json, '$.ExecutableInfo'), '')
            || ' ' || COALESCE(json_extract_string(payload_json, '$.PayloadData4'), '')
            || ' ' || COALESCE(json_extract_string(payload_json, '$.PayloadData3'), '')
            || ' ' || COALESCE(json_extract_string(payload_json, '$.PayloadData2'), '') AS path_combined

    WHERE case_id = ?
      AND artifact_id = 'evtx'
      AND json_extract_string(payload_json, '$.Channel') = 'Microsoft-Windows-TaskScheduler/Operational'
      AND CAST(json_extract_string(payload_json, '$.EventId') AS INTEGER) = 129

SELECT
    audit_id, ts_utc, artifact_id, event_type,
    json_extract_string(payload_json, '$.PayloadData1') AS task_name,
    json_extract_string(payload_json, '$.PayloadData4') AS task_path,
    json_extract_string(payload_json, '$.ExecutableInfo') AS executable_info
FROM filtered
WHERE path_combined ILIKE '%C:\Windows\Temp\%'
   OR path_combined ILIKE '%\AppData\Local\Temp\%'
   OR path_combined ILIKE '%\Desktop\%'
   OR path_combined ILIKE '%\Downloads\%'

WITH svc AS (

        audit_id, ts_utc, artifact_id, event_type,

     OR image_path ILIKE '%regsvr32%'

     OR image_path ILIKE '%wscript%'

  AND (
        image_path ILIKE '% -c %'

AND artifact_id = 'evtx' AND json_extract_string(payload_json, '$.Channel') = 'Microsoft-Windows-PowerShell/Operational' AND CAST(json_extract_string(payload_json, '$.EventId') AS INTEGER) = 4103) SELECT audit_id, ts_utc, artifact_id, event_type, json_extract_string(payload_json, '$.PayloadData1') AS payload_data1, json_extract_string(payload_json, '$.PayloadData2') AS payload_data2, json_extract_string(payload_json, '$.PayloadData3') AS payload_data3, json_extract_string(payload_json, '$.ExecutableInfo') AS executable_info FROM ps_events WHERE ps_payload ILIKE '%&&%' AND ps_payload ILIKE '%rundll32%' AND ps_payload ILIKE '%shell32.dll%' AND ps_payload ILIKE '%shellexec_rundll%' AND (ps_payload ILIKE '%value%' OR ps_payload ILIKE '%invoke%' OR ps_payload ILIKE '%comspec%' OR ps_payload ILIKE '%iex%')

WITH ps_mod AS (
  SELECT
    audit_id, ts_utc, artifact_id, event_type,
    json_extract_string(payload_json, '$.PayloadData1') AS context_info,
    json_extract_string(payload_json, '$.PayloadData2') AS payload_data,
    LOWER(CONCAT(
      COALESCE(json_extract_string(payload_json, '$.PayloadData1'), ''), ' ',
      COALESCE(json_extract_string(payload_json, '$.PayloadData2'), ''), ' ',
      COALESCE(json_extract_string(payload_json, '$.PayloadData3'), ''), ' ',
      COALESCE(json_extract_string(payload_json, '$.PayloadData4'), ''), ' ',
      COALESCE(json_extract_string(payload_json, '$.ExecutableInfo'), '')
    )) AS search_text
  FROM unified_events
  WHERE case_id = ?
    AND artifact_id = 'evtx'
    AND json_extract_string(payload_json, '$.Channel') = 'Microsoft-Windows-PowerShell/Operational'
    AND CAST(json_extract_string(payload_json, '$.EventId') AS INTEGER) = 4103
)
SELECT
  audit_id, ts_utc, artifact_id, event_type,
  context_info, payload_data
FROM ps_mod
WHERE
  search_text LIKE '%get-localgroup %'
  OR search_text LIKE '%get-localgroupmember %'
  OR (
    (
      search_text LIKE '%get-wmiobject %'
      OR search_text LIKE '%gwmi %'
      OR search_text LIKE '%get-ciminstance %'
      OR search_text LIKE '%gcim %'
    )
    AND search_text LIKE '%win32_group%'
  )
